Sect: Sabbat

Born of brutal Tzimisce and Tremere blood-magic experiments in Old World castles and chantries, the Blood Brothers are not truly a clan but an artificial bloodline of soldiers and servants. Linked by a literal hive-mind shared among the members of a 'circle,' they coordinate seamlessly even across distance, making them ideal for security, sabotage, and synchronized assaults. Despite the name, unconfirmed rumors persist of female members.

Disciplines: Fortitude, Potence, Sanguinus

Advantage: Selected for their hardiness and toughened further by their mystical creation, Blood Brothers begin with two additional endurance-related Physical Traits (such as Enduring, Resilient, Stalwart, or Tough) at character creation.

Disadvantage: Blood Brother vitae is sterile - they are not true Cainites and cannot Embrace mortals as childer (though they can create ghouls); any mortal a Blood Brother attempts to sire simply dies. The hive-mind also shares weaknesses as well as strengths: any circle member's Negative Physical or Social Traits may be bid against any other member of the same circle in challenges.

Organization: Blood Brothers operate exclusively in tight-knit circles bound by their shared mind, rarely if ever acting outside the unit that was created with them.

See also: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{the Sabbat} - the antitribu designation itself marks this bloodline's members as having sided with the Sabbat rather than the Camarilla.
